+import {
+  ONBOARDING_REGISTRATION_COMPLETE_PATH,
+  deriveFormalOnboardingResumeStep,
+  readOnboardingRegistrationCompletePayload,
+  useOnboardingFlowState,
+} from "@procertus-ui/ui-certification";
+import { useMemo } from "react";
+import { Navigate } from "react-router-dom";
+
+import { formalOnboardingStepPath } from "../../routes/formal-request-routing";
+
+const WEGWIJZER_PATH = "/welcome";
+
+/**
+ * `/welcome/formal-request` without a step segment: sends users to the step implied by stored flow
+ * data (drafts + context), or away when the session cannot continue here.
+ */
+export function FormalRequestStepRedirect() {
+  const { flowState, resolvedContext } = useOnboardingFlowState();
+
+  const registrationCompletePayload = useMemo(
+    () => readOnboardingRegistrationCompletePayload(),
+    [],
+  );
+
+  const resumeStep = useMemo(
+    () => deriveFormalOnboardingResumeStep(flowState, resolvedContext),
+    [flowState, resolvedContext],
+  );
+
+  const target = useMemo(
+    () => formalOnboardingStepPath(resumeStep),
+    [resumeStep],
+  );
+
+  if (registrationCompletePayload) {
+    return <Navigate to={ONBOARDING_REGISTRATION_COMPLETE_PATH} replace />;
+  }
+
+  if (flowState.drafts.length === 0) {
+    return <Navigate to={WEGWIJZER_PATH} replace />;
+  }

+  }, [flowState, resolvedContext]);

content.text:
Here’s what was implemented. ### Unified guest chrome in `PublicAppShell` `PublicAppShell` now wraps all `/welcome/*` routes with: - `DensityProvider` (`density="operational"`) - `PublicRegistryAppShell` with logo, `onLogin` / `loginUrl` (`PUBLIC_GUEST_LOGIN_PATH`), `WelcomePublicHeaderLeading`, `WelcomePublicHeaderTrailing`, `guestLanguagePlacement: "leading"`, and prototype registry language props from `usePublicPrototypeRegistryLanguageHeaderProps()` - `APP_FOOTER` - `ActiveInquiryContinueAlert` in a capped `max-w-7xl` strip above `` - Existing `OnboardingFlowProvider`, `PublicPrototypeLanguageProvider`, and `AlertDialogProvider` Inner routing chrome lives in `PublicGuestRegistryChrome` so hooks stay under the language provider. ```26:61:/Users/psoudan/workspace/05-Procertus/Procertus-ui-experiment/apps/frontend-pt1-extranet-onboarding/src/layouts/PublicAppShell.tsx function PublicGuestRegistryChrome() { const navigate = useNavigate(); const registryLang = usePublicPrototypeRegistryLanguageHeaderProps(); return ( ), onLogin: () => navigate(PUBLIC_GUEST_LOGIN_PATH), loginUrl: PUBLIC_GUEST_LOGIN_PATH, leadingActions: , trailingActions: , guestLanguagePlacement: "leading", ...registryLang, }} footer={APP_FOOTER} >
); } ``` ### Pages no longer repeat the registry shell - **`WegwijzerPage`** — only the `max-w-7xl` body (hero + explorer). - **Traject / triage / placeholders** — use **`TrajectPageFrame`** (no inner `PublicRegistryAppShell`). - **Info / expert call** — still use **`DensityProvider density="spacious"`** around `ExpertCallBookingView` only; the outer shell stays operational. ### `TrajectLayout` vs `TrajectPageFrame` (`ui-certification`) - **`TrajectPageFrame`** — shared title column + sticky action bar (same as before, minus shell). - **`TrajectLayout`** — Storybook / standalone: `PublicRegistryAppShell` + `TrajectPageFrame` (unchanged story API). ### Formal onboarding without double shell - **`OnboardingShell`** — `embedded?: boolean`; when true, renders only the inner `PageHeader` + children (no registry shell). - **`OnboardingFlowView`** — `embeddedRegistryShell?: boolean` plumbed through. - **`CustomerOnboardingFlow`** — sets `embeddedRegistryShell`, drops duplicate header/language props (shell owns them). ### Routing - **`PublicWelcomeOnboardingSessionLayout`** removed; routes are direct children of `PublicAppShell`. - **`PublicWelcomeOnboardingSessionLayout.tsx`** deleted. `bun run build` for `apps/frontend-pt1-extranet-onboarding` completes successfully. [REDACTED]

Inspecting footer, shell, and traject action-bar styling to fix dark-mode token usage.

[REDACTED]

Identifying the cause: `globals.css` forces light neutrals on `[data-slot="footer"]` and `[data-slot="traject-action-bar"]` for all `data-public-layout` pages, overriding dark theme tokens. Scoping those overrides to `html[data-public-layout].light` so dark mode uses semantic tokens.

[REDACTED]

Using `:not(.dark)` so we match light mode even if only `light` is omitted (Storybook always sets one of them).

+import {
+  ONBOARDING_REGISTRATION_COMPLETE_PATH,
+  deriveFormalOnboardingResumeStep,
+  readOnboardingRegistrationCompletePayload,
+  useOnboardingFlowState,
+} from "@procertus-ui/ui-certification";
+import { useMemo } from "react";
+import { Navigate } from "react-router-dom";
+
+import { formalOnboardingStepPath } from "../../routes/formal-request-routing";
+
+const WEGWIJZER_PATH = "/welcome";
+
+/**
+ * `/welcome/formal-request` without a step segment: sends users to the step implied by stored flow
+ * data (drafts + context), or away when the session cannot continue here.
+ */
+export function FormalRequestStepRedirect() {
+  const { flowState, resolvedContext } = useOnboardingFlowState();
+
+  const registrationCompletePayload = useMemo(
+    () => readOnboardingRegistrationCompletePayload(),
+    [],
+  );
+
+  const resumeStep = useMemo(
+    () => deriveFormalOnboardingResumeStep(flowState, resolvedContext),
+    [flowState, resolvedContext],
+  );
+
+  const target = useMemo(
+    () => formalOnboardingStepPath(resumeStep),
+    [resumeStep],
+  );
+
+  if (registrationCompletePayload) {
+    return <Navigate to={ONBOARDING_REGISTRATION_COMPLETE_PATH} replace />;
+  }
+
+  if (flowState.drafts.length === 0) {
+    return <Navigate to={WEGWIJZER_PATH} replace />;
+  }
+
+  return <Navigate to={target} replace />;
+}

+import { useOnboardingFlowApi } from "@procertus-ui/ui-certification";

+/**
+ * Persist Wegwijzer service id + display label onto {@link OnboardingFlowState} whenever this
+ * route segment is tied to an entry (triage · traject wizard · placeholders).
+ */
+export function useSyncOnboardingTrajectFromServiceId(serviceId: string | undefined) {
+  const api = useOnboardingFlowApi();
+  useEffect(() => {
+    const id = serviceId?.trim();
+    if (!id) return;
+    const svc = findWegwijzerService(id);
+    if (!svc) return;
+    api.setTrajectServiceId(id, svc.entry.label);
+  }, [api, serviceId]);
+}

+import { ArrowRight02Icon } from "@hugeicons/core-free-icons";
+import { HugeiconsIcon } from "@hugeicons/react";
+import { Alert, AlertDescription, AlertTitle, Button } from "@procertus-ui/ui";
+import {
+  deriveFormalOnboardingResumeStep,
+  effectiveIncludedCertificationDraftIds,
+  useOnboardingFlowState,
+} from "@procertus-ui/ui-certification";
+import { useMemo } from "react";
+import { Link, useLocation } from "react-router-dom";
+
+import { FORMAL_ONBOARDING_PATH, formalOnboardingStepPath } from "../routes/formal-request-routing";
+
+/**
+ * Shown on guest “intake” pages when the session already has certification inquiries selected,
+ * so users know they can continue the in‑progress request instead of only browsing.
+ */
+export function ActiveInquiryContinueAlert() {
+  const location = useLocation();
+  const { flowState, resolvedContext } = useOnboardingFlowState();
+
+  const includedCount = useMemo(
+    () =>
+      effectiveIncludedCertificationDraftIds(
+        flowState.drafts,
+        flowState.summaryIncludedDraftIds,
+      ).length,
+    [flowState.drafts, flowState.summaryIncludedDraftIds],
+  );
+
+  const continuePath = useMemo(() => {
+    const step = deriveFormalOnboardingResumeStep(flowState, resolvedContext);
+    return formalOnboardingStepPath(step);
+  }, [flowState, resolvedContext]);
+
+  if (includedCount === 0) {
+    return null;
+  }
+
+  if (location.pathname.startsWith(FORMAL_ONBOARDING_PATH)) {
+    return null;
+  }
+
+  return (
+    <Alert className="border-primary/25 bg-primary/5">
+      <AlertTitle>Actieve aanvraag met onderzoeken</AlertTitle>
+      <AlertDescription className="flex flex-col gap-component sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
+        <span className="text-sm leading-normal">
+          U hebt een lopende aanvraag met{" "}
+          {includedCount === 1
+            ? "één geselecteerd certificatieonderzoek"
+            : `${includedCount} geselecteerde certificatieonderzoeken`}
+          . U kunt deze aanvraag op elk moment verderzetten.
+        </span>
+        <Button variant="default" size="sm" className="shrink-0 gap-micro" asChild>
+          <Link to={continuePath}>
+            Ga verder met aanvraag
+            <HugeiconsIcon icon={ArrowRight02Icon} className="size-4" aria-hidden />
+          </Link>
+        </Button>
+      </AlertDescription>
+    </Alert>
+  );
+}

content.text:
### Cause

On guest routes, `apps/frontend-pt1-extranet-onboarding/src/index.css` moves scrolling to **`html`** (`overflow-y: auto` on `html[data-public-layout]`).

`TrajectPageFrame` still picked the **first** ancestor with `overflow-y: auto` — the `PublicRegistryAppShell` root. In practice the page scroll happens on **`documentElement`**, so that shell node often never scrolls (`scrollTop` stays `0`, `scrollHeight` ≈ `clientHeight`). The code always treated that as “at bottom”, kept `hasContentBelow` false, and the fade stayed at **`opacity-0`** in both themes.

### Fix

Scroll-root detection in ```74:138:/Users/psoudan/workspace/05-Procertus/Procertus-ui-experiment/packages/ui-certification/src/components/traject/TrajectLayout.tsx``` now:

1. Walks ancestors with `overflow: auto | scroll | overlay` but **only uses** them if `scrollHeight > clientHeight + 2` (they actually scroll).
2. Otherwise uses **`document.documentElement`** (and listens on **`window`** for scroll).
3. If nothing qualifies yet (layout still settling), it **still** attaches document scroll + resize observers so the gradient can appear once content grows.

The gradient styling (`bg-linear-to-t from-card`) was fine; only the visibility gate was wrong.

[REDACTED]

+import {
+  ONBOARDING_REGISTRATION_COMPLETE_PATH,
+  deriveFormalOnboardingResumeStep,
+  readOnboardingRegistrationCompletePayload,
+  useOnboardingFlowState,
+} from "@procertus-ui/ui-certification";
+import { useMemo } from "react";
+import { Navigate } from "react-router-dom";
+
+import { formalOnboardingStepPath } from "../../routes/formal-request-routing";
+
+const WEGWIJZER_PATH = "/welcome";
+
+/**
+ * `/welcome/formal-request` without a step segment: sends users to the step implied by stored flow
+ * data (drafts + context), or away when the session cannot continue here.
+ */
+export function FormalRequestStepRedirect() {
+  const { flowState, resolvedContext } = useOnboardingFlowState();
+
+  const registrationCompletePayload = useMemo(
+    () => readOnboardingRegistrationCompletePayload(),
+    [],
+  );
+
+  const resumeStep = useMemo(
+    () => deriveFormalOnboardingResumeStep(flowState, resolvedContext),
+    [flowState, resolvedContext],
+  );
+
+  const target = useMemo(
+    () => formalOnboardingStepPath(resumeStep),
+    [resumeStep],
+  );
+
+  if (registrationCompletePayload) {
+    return <Navigate to={ONBOARDING_REGISTRATION_COMPLETE_PATH} replace />;
+  }
+
+  if (flowState.drafts.length === 0) {
+    return <Navigate to={WEGWIJZER_PATH} replace />;
+  }
+
+  return <Navigate to={target} replace />;
+}

+import { ArrowRight02Icon } from "@hugeicons/core-free-icons";

+import { Alert, AlertDescription, AlertTitle, Button } from "@procertus-ui/ui";
+import {
+  deriveFormalOnboardingResumeStep,
+  effectiveIncludedCertificationDraftIds,
+  useOnboardingFlowState,
+} from "@procertus-ui/ui-certification";
+import { useMemo } from "react";
+import { Link, useLocation } from "react-router-dom";
+
+import { FORMAL_ONBOARDING_PATH, formalOnboardingStepPath } from "../routes/formal-request-routing";
+
+/**
+ * Shown on guest “intake” pages when the session already has certification inquiries selected,
+ * so users know they can continue the in‑progress request instead of only browsing.
+ */
+export function ActiveInquiryContinueAlert() {
+  const location = useLocation();
+  const { flowState, resolvedContext } = useOnboardingFlowState();
+
+  const includedCount = useMemo(
+    () =>
+      effectiveIncludedCertificationDraftIds(
+        flowState.drafts,
+        flowState.summaryIncludedDraftIds,
+      ).length,
+    [flowState.drafts, flowState.summaryIncludedDraftIds],
+  );
+
+  const continuePath = useMemo(() => {
+    const step = deriveFormalOnboardingResumeStep(flowState, resolvedContext);
+    return formalOnboardingStepPath(step);
+  }, [flowState, resolvedContext]);
+
+  if (includedCount === 0) {
+    return null;
+  }
+
+  if (location.pathname.startsWith(FORMAL_ONBOARDING_PATH)) {
+    return null;
+  }
+
+  return (
+    <Alert className="border-primary/25 bg-primary/5">
+      <AlertTitle>Actieve aanvraag met onderzoeken</AlertTitle>
+      <AlertDescription className="flex flex-col gap-component sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
+        <span className="text-sm leading-normal">
+          U hebt een lopende aanvraag met{" "}
+          {includedCount === 1
+            ? "één geselecteerd certificatieonderzoek"
+            : `${includedCount} geselecteerde certificatieonderzoeken`}
+          . U kunt deze aanvraag op elk moment verderzetten.
+        </span>
+        <Button variant="default" size="sm" className="shrink-0 gap-micro" asChild>
+          <Link to={continuePath}>
+            Ga verder met aanvraag
+            <HugeiconsIcon icon={ArrowRight02Icon} className="size-4" aria-hidden />
+          </Link>
+        </Button>
+      </AlertDescription>
+    </Alert>
+  );
+}

+import { useMemo } from "react";
+import { Navigate } from "react-router-dom";

+import { formalOnboardingStepPath } from "../../routes/formal-request-routing";

+const WEGWIJZER_PATH = "/welcome";

+/**

+ * data (drafts + context), or away when the session cannot continue here.

+  const resumeStep = useMemo(

+    [flowState, resolvedContext],

+
+  const target = useMemo(
+    () => formalOnboardingStepPath(resumeStep),
+    [resumeStep],
+  );
+
+  if (registrationCompletePayload) {
+    return <Navigate to={ONBOARDING_REGISTRATION_COMPLETE_PATH} replace />;

+  }

+/**
+ * Shown on guest “intake” pages when the session already has certification inquiries selected,
+ * so users know they can continue the in‑progress request instead of only browsing.
+ */
+export function ActiveInquiryContinueAlert() {
+  const location = useLocation();

+  const includedCount = useMemo(

+  if (includedCount === 0) {
+    return null;
+  }
+
+  if (location.pathname.startsWith(FORMAL_ONBOARDING_PATH)) {
+    return null;
+  }
+

+      <AlertTitle>Actieve aanvraag met onderzoeken</AlertTitle>

+        <span className="text-sm leading-normal">

+            ? "één geselecteerd certificatieonderzoek"
+            : `${includedCount} geselecteerde certificatieonderzoeken`}
+          . U kunt deze aanvraag op elk moment verderzetten.

+          </Link>
+        </Button>
+      </AlertDescription>
+    </Alert>
+  );
+}

+import {
+  ONBOARDING_REGISTRATION_COMPLETE_PATH,
+  deriveFormalOnboardingResumeStep,
+  readOnboardingRegistrationCompletePayload,
+  useOnboardingFlowState,
+} from "@procertus-ui/ui-certification";
+import { useMemo } from "react";
+import { Navigate } from "react-router-dom";
+
+import { formalOnboardingStepPath } from "../../routes/formal-request-routing";
+
+const WEGWIJZER_PATH = "/welcome";
+
+/**
+ * `/welcome/formal-request` without a step segment: sends users to the step implied by stored flow
+ * data (drafts + context), or away when the session cannot continue here.
+ */
+export function FormalRequestStepRedirect() {
+  const { flowState, resolvedContext } = useOnboardingFlowState();
+
+  const registrationCompletePayload = useMemo(
+    () => readOnboardingRegistrationCompletePayload(),
+    [],
+  );
+
+  const resumeStep = useMemo(
+    () => deriveFormalOnboardingResumeStep(flowState, resolvedContext),
+    [flowState, resolvedContext],
+  );
+
+  const target = useMemo(
+    () => formalOnboardingStepPath(resumeStep),
+    [resumeStep],
+  );
+
+  if (registrationCompletePayload) {
+    return <Navigate to={ONBOARDING_REGISTRATION_COMPLETE_PATH} replace />;
+  }
+
+  if (flowState.drafts.length === 0) {
+    return <Navigate to={WEGWIJZER_PATH} replace />;
+  }
+
+  return <Navigate to={target} replace />;
+}

+import { ArrowRight02Icon } from "@hugeicons/core-free-icons";
+import { HugeiconsIcon } from "@hugeicons/react";
+import { Alert, AlertDescription, AlertTitle, Button } from "@procertus-ui/ui";
+import {
+  deriveFormalOnboardingResumeStep,
+  effectiveIncludedCertificationDraftIds,
+  useOnboardingFlowState,
+} from "@procertus-ui/ui-certification";
+import { useMemo } from "react";
+import { Link, useLocation } from "react-router-dom";
+
+import { FORMAL_ONBOARDING_PATH, formalOnboardingStepPath } from "../routes/formal-request-routing";
+
+/**
+ * Shown on guest “intake” pages when the session already has certification inquiries selected,
+ * so users know they can continue the in‑progress request instead of only browsing.
+ */
+export function ActiveInquiryContinueAlert() {
+  const location = useLocation();
+  const { flowState, resolvedContext } = useOnboardingFlowState();
+
+  const includedCount = useMemo(
+    () =>
+      effectiveIncludedCertificationDraftIds(
+        flowState.drafts,
+        flowState.summaryIncludedDraftIds,
+      ).length,
+    [flowState.drafts, flowState.summaryIncludedDraftIds],
+  );
+
+  const continuePath = useMemo(() => {
+    const step = deriveFormalOnboardingResumeStep(flowState, resolvedContext);
+    return formalOnboardingStepPath(step);
+  }, [flowState, resolvedContext]);
+
+  if (includedCount === 0) {
+    return null;
+  }
+
+  if (location.pathname.startsWith(FORMAL_ONBOARDING_PATH)) {
+    return null;
+  }
+
+  return (
+    <Alert className="border-primary/25 bg-primary/5">
+      <AlertTitle>Actieve aanvraag met onderzoeken</AlertTitle>
+      <AlertDescription className="flex flex-col gap-component sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
+        <span className="text-sm leading-normal">
+          U hebt een lopende aanvraag met{" "}
+          {includedCount === 1
+            ? "één geselecteerd certificatieonderzoek"
+            : `${includedCount} geselecteerde certificatieonderzoeken`}
+          . U kunt deze aanvraag op elk moment verderzetten.
+        </span>
+        <Button variant="default" size="sm" className="shrink-0 gap-micro" asChild>
+          <Link to={continuePath}>
+            Ga verder met aanvraag
+            <HugeiconsIcon icon={ArrowRight02Icon} className="size-4" aria-hidden />
+          </Link>
+        </Button>
+      </AlertDescription>
+    </Alert>
+  );
+}

content.text:
Here’s what was implemented.

### Continue-banner visibility (shell-only)

- Added **`useActiveFormalInquiryContinueBanner`** in `@procertus-ui/ui-certification` (`use-active-formal-inquiry-continue-banner.ts`). It returns `{ visible, includedCount, resumeStep }` when:
  - registration is **not** marked complete (`readOnboardingRegistrationCompletePayload()` is null),
  - there is **at least one included certification draft**,
  - **`requestOrigin !== ""`** (user has committed past the formal **origin** step — i.e. formal onboarding really started),
  - **`pathname` does not** start with the formal prefix you pass in (same behavior as before for hiding on `/welcome/formal-request/...`).
- **`PublicGuestRegistryChrome`** uses `useLocation`, that hook, and `formalOnboardingStepPath(resumeStep)`; it only renders **`ActiveInquiryContinueAlert`** when `visible` is true.
- **`ActiveInquiryContinueAlert`** is now **presentational only**: props `includedCount` and `continuePath`.

### Onboarding flow state & API (provider-backed persistence)

On **`OnboardingFlowState`** (`onboarding-types.ts`):

- **`guestIntakeChannel`**: `"" | "formal" | "informational" | "expert-call"` (constants **`GUEST_INTAKE_CHANNELS`**).
- **`informalIntakeServiceId`**, **`informalIntake`** (snapshot aligned with the booking form).

On **`createOnboardingFlowApi`**:

- **`setRequestOrigin`** also sets **`guestIntakeChannel: "formal"`**.
- **`setGuestIntakeChannel`**, **`patchInformalIntakeCapture`**, **`clearInformalIntakeCapture`**.
- Hydration / bootstrap ensures **`guestIntakeChannel`** defaults correctly.

### Informal routes wiring

- **`InfoRequestPlaceholderPage`** / **`ExpertCallPlaceholderPage`**: if **`requestOrigin`** is still empty, they call **`setGuestIntakeChannel("informational"|"expert-call", …)`** (so exploring informal flows doesn’t overwrite once formal registration has started).
- **`ExpertCallBookingView`**: optional **`onPersistedSnapshotChange`** (exported type **`ExpertCallBookingPersistedSnapshot`**); both placeholder pages pass **`api.patchInformalIntakeCapture`**.
- Info-request submit still clears session storage and now calls **`clearInformalIntakeCapture()`**.

### Other

- **`flowStateSeedFromOnboardingFlowViewProps`** seeds **`guestIntakeChannel: "formal"`** when `requestOrigin` is set (Storybook).
- **`packages/ui-certification` `tsc`** still reports many existing workspace/story issues; **`apps/frontend-pt1-extranet-onboarding` build** succeeds.

Formal vs informal **intent** is reflected in **`guestIntakeChannel`** (and implicitly **`requestOrigin`** for formal progress); informal **field-level** data lives in **`informalIntake`** alongside the existing **`context`** used for registration.

+import {
+  ONBOARDING_REGISTRATION_COMPLETE_PATH,
+  deriveFormalOnboardingResumeStep,
+  readOnboardingRegistrationCompletePayload,
+  useOnboardingFlowState,
+} from "@procertus-ui/ui-certification";
+import { useMemo } from "react";
+import { Navigate } from "react-router-dom";
+
+import { formalOnboardingStepPath } from "../../routes/formal-request-routing";
+
+const WEGWIJZER_PATH = "/welcome";
+
+/**
+ * `/welcome/formal-request` without a step segment: sends users to the step implied by stored flow
+ * data (drafts + context), or away when the session cannot continue here.
+ */
+export function FormalRequestStepRedirect() {
+  const { flowState, resolvedContext } = useOnboardingFlowState();
+
+  const registrationCompletePayload = useMemo(
+    () => readOnboardingRegistrationCompletePayload(),
+    [],
+  );
+
+  const resumeStep = useMemo(
+    () => deriveFormalOnboardingResumeStep(flowState, resolvedContext),
+    [flowState, resolvedContext],
+  );
+
+  const target = useMemo(
+    () => formalOnboardingStepPath(resumeStep),
+    [resumeStep],
+  );
+
+  if (registrationCompletePayload) {
+    return <Navigate to={ONBOARDING_REGISTRATION_COMPLETE_PATH} replace />;
+  }
+
+  if (flowState.drafts.length === 0) {
+    return <Navigate to={WEGWIJZER_PATH} replace />;
+  }
+
+  return <Navigate to={target} replace />;
+}

+export function useSyncOnboardingTrajectFromServiceId(serviceId: string | undefined) {

Here’s what changed:

### `useActiveFormalInquiryContinueBanner` (`ui-certification`)

The hook now returns:

- **`sessionActive`** — `registrationCompletePayload == null`, at least one **included** draft, and **`requestOrigin !== ""`** (same core rules as before).
- **`visible`** — `sessionActive && !pathname.startsWith(formalPrefix)` (banner only **off** the formal route).

So the banner and cart share **`sessionActive`**; only the banner also hides on `/welcome/formal-request`.

### `PublicAppShell`

- Imports **`PublicCertificationRequestsCart`** and sets  
  `trailingActions: formalBanner.sessionActive ? <PublicCertificationRequestsCart /> : null`.
- **`WelcomePublicHeaderTrailing.tsx`** was removed as unnecessary indirection.

+import { useMemo } from "react";
+import { Navigate } from "react-router-dom";
+
+import { formalOnboardingStepPath } from "../../routes/formal-request-routing";
+
+const WEGWIJZER_PATH = "/welcome";
+
+/**
+ * `/welcome/formal-request` without a step segment: sends users to the step implied by stored flow
+ * data (drafts + context), or away when the session cannot continue here.
+ */
+export function FormalRequestStepRedirect() {

+
+  const registrationCompletePayload = useMemo(
+    () => readOnboardingRegistrationCompletePayload(),
+    [],
+  );
+
+  const resumeStep = useMemo(
+    () => deriveFormalOnboardingResumeStep(flowState, resolvedContext),
+    [flowState, resolvedContext],
+  );
+
+  const target = useMemo(
+    () => formalOnboardingStepPath(resumeStep),
+    [resumeStep],
+  );
+
+  if (registrationCompletePayload) {
+    return <Navigate to={ONBOARDING_REGISTRATION_COMPLETE_PATH} replace />;
+  }
+
+  if (flowState.drafts.length === 0) {
+    return <Navigate to={WEGWIJZER_PATH} replace />;
+  }
+
+  return <Navigate to={target} replace />;
+}

content.text:
Here’s what was going wrong and what we changed.

### Cause

1. **Logo** — `PublicRegistryHeader` always rendered `<a href="/">`, so you left the SPA and hit the app root with a **full load**.
2. **Log in** — The header used `<a href={loginUrl} onClick={onLogin}>`. Your shell passed `onLogin={() => navigate(...)}`, but **`preventDefault` was never called**, so the browser still followed `href` and did a **full navigation** to `/login`.

### Changes in `@procertus-ui/ui` (`public-header.tsx`)

- **`logoHref`** (default `"/"`) — semantic URL for the logo (open in new tab, copy link).
- **`onLogoClick`** — when set, the logo anchor runs `preventDefault` and then calls this (for React Router / SPA).
- **Login** — when `onLogin` is set, the click handler runs `preventDefault` before `onLogin()`.

So the header stays presentational: it only wires `href` + optional client handlers; it doesn’t import the router.

### Changes in the app (`PublicAppShell` + `guestPaths`)

- Introduced **`PUBLIC_GUEST_WELCOME_PATH`** (`"/welcome"`) next to the login path constant.
- Header config now includes:

  - `logoHref: PUBLIC_GUEST_WELCOME_PATH`
  - `onLogoClick: () => navigate(PUBLIC_GUEST_WELCOME_PATH)`
  - `loginUrl` + `onLogin: () => navigate(PUBLIC_GUEST_LOGIN_PATH)` (with the new `preventDefault` behavior in the UI component)

Logo and login both use **client-side navigation** in dev (including HMR-friendly routing), while keeping sensible `href`s for accessibility and middle-click.

Compared to **`Button asChild` + `Link`**, this is the usual pattern when you want **`navigate(...)`** (e.g. extra logic later, or avoiding `asChild`). Trade-off: no built‑in “open in new tab” from a URL; if you need that again, combine **`href` + `onClick` with `preventDefault`** when handling in-app, similar to the registry header login link.

+import {
+  ONBOARDING_REGISTRATION_COMPLETE_PATH,
+  deriveFormalOnboardingResumeStep,
+  readOnboardingRegistrationCompletePayload,
+  useOnboardingFlowState,
+} from "@procertus-ui/ui-certification";
+import { useMemo } from "react";
+import { Navigate } from "react-router-dom";
+
+import { formalOnboardingStepPath } from "../../routes/formal-request-routing";
+
+const WEGWIJZER_PATH = "/welcome";
+
+/**
+ * `/welcome/formal-request` without a step segment: sends users to the step implied by stored flow
+ * data (drafts + context), or away when the session cannot continue here.
+ */
+export function FormalRequestStepRedirect() {
+  const { flowState, resolvedContext } = useOnboardingFlowState();
+
+  const registrationCompletePayload = useMemo(
+    () => readOnboardingRegistrationCompletePayload(),
+    [],
+  );
+
+  const resumeStep = useMemo(
+    () => deriveFormalOnboardingResumeStep(flowState, resolvedContext),
+    [flowState, resolvedContext],
+  );
+
+  const target = useMemo(
+    () => formalOnboardingStepPath(resumeStep),
+    [resumeStep],
+  );
+
+  if (registrationCompletePayload) {
+    return <Navigate to={ONBOARDING_REGISTRATION_COMPLETE_PATH} replace />;
+  }
+
+  if (flowState.drafts.length === 0) {
+    return <Navigate to={WEGWIJZER_PATH} replace />;
+  }
+
+  return <Navigate to={target} replace />;
+}

+import { useOnboardingFlowApi } from "@procertus-ui/ui-certification";
+import { useEffect } from "react";
+
+import { findWegwijzerService } from "../wegwijzer/wegwijzer-services";
+
+/**
+ * Persist Wegwijzer service id + display label onto {@link OnboardingFlowState} whenever this
+ * route segment is tied to an entry (triage · traject wizard · placeholders).
+ */
+export function useSyncOnboardingTrajectFromServiceId(serviceId: string | undefined) {
+  const api = useOnboardingFlowApi();
+  useEffect(() => {
+    const id = serviceId?.trim();
+    if (!id) return;
+    const svc = findWegwijzerService(id);
+    if (!svc) return;
+    api.setTrajectServiceId(id, svc.entry.label);
